cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/tmp python3 - <<'PY'
from tools import *
import random,json
random.seed(4)
N=4096;E=16384;R=2048;G=11
states=[f'S{i:04d}' for i in range(N)]
En={'name':'E','kind':'enum','values':states};Str={'name':'S','kind':'string','maxsize':0};B={'name':'B','kind':'bool'}
params=[['state','E'],['message','S']]+[[f'b{i}','B'] for i in range(G)]
trans=[];seen=set()
for i in range(E):
 fr=random.randrange(N);cmd='c'+str(i)
 # ensure unique
 while (fr,cmd) in seen:
  fr=random.randrange(N);cmd='d'+str(i)+'x'
 seen.add((fr,cmd));to=random.randrange(N);cost=random.randint(1,65535)
 g=None
 if i<G*50:
  gi=i%G
  g=['var',f'b{gi}']
 trans.append({'from':states[fr],'to':states[to],'command':cmd,'cost':cost,'when':g})
machine={'states':states,'initial':states[0],'state_param':'state','message_param':'message','transitions':trans}
mods=[{'name':'e','params':params,'result':['r','B'],'requires':None}]
# layout state x0; msg buffer x1 max0; b0..b10 x2..x12; result x13
runs=[]
for i in range(R):
 objs={'x0':(N-1).to_bytes(4,'little'),'x13':b'\0'}
 for j in range(G): objs[f'x{2+j}']=bytes([(i>>j)&1])
 runs.append({'entry':'e','ktest':ktest(objs)})
camp=base(types=[En,Str,B],modules=mods,entries=['e'],machine=machine,runs=runs)
data=json.dumps(camp,separators=(',',':')).encode();print('size',len(data))
open('/workspace/tmp/big3.json','wb').write(data)
PY
